prompt: Chloe asked the landlord when (the electrician / can / to come).
explanation_ru: В косвенном специальном вопросе после when используется прямой порядок слов, а модальный глагол can сдвигается в could.

prompt: Security staff asked Declan ___ any glass bottles in his bag.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос вводится через if/whether с прямым порядком слов (he was carrying), без инверсии и без союза that.

prompt: My flatmate asked me how (I / to clean) the coffee machine.
explanation_ru: После how в косвенном вопросе порядок слов прямой, вспомогательный глагол do убирается, а clean переходит в Past Simple (cleaned).

prompt: A friendly passer-by asked us ___ for the old bookshop.
explanation_ru: После asked в прошедшем времени общий вопрос требует союза if/whether, прямого порядка слов и сдвига Present Continuous в Past Continuous (we were looking).

prompt: Ewa wondered how much (the bike repair / to cost).
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе после wondered how much сохраняется прямой порядок слов без does, а глагол cost в Past Simple сохраняет форму cost.

prompt: Faisal asked his sister how did she open the heavy tin.
answer: Faisal asked his sister how she had opened the heavy tin.
accepted_answers: Faisal asked his sister how she had opened the heavy tin.
Faisal asked his sister how she'd opened the heavy tin.
Faisal asked his sister how she opened the heavy tin.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе нельзя оставлять вспомогательный глагол did и вопросительный порядок слов: подлежащее ставится перед глаголом, а Past Simple сдвигается в Past Perfect (she had opened).

prompt: Cold wind blew across the football pitch, so the coach asked Hugo (he / to remember) his gloves before leaving home.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос о предшествующем действии вводится через if/whether с прямым порядком слов, а Past Simple сдвигается в Past Perfect (he had remembered).

prompt: The parcel sat open in the hall when I got home, so I asked my brother when (it / to arrive).
explanation_ru: Посылка пришла раньше момента возвращения домой, поэтому в косвенном вопросе после when используется прямой порядок слов и Past Perfect (it had arrived).

prompt: Ines texted me after the lesson and asked (my sister / to pass) her driving test yet.
explanation_ru: Маркер yet указывает на Present Perfect в прямом вопросе, который в косвенной речи переходит в Past Perfect с союзом if/whether (if my sister had passed).

prompt: Water still dripped under the sink, so Jarek asked his neighbour ___ a phone number.
options: whether had the plumber not left
explanation_ru: В отрицательном косвенном вопросе сохраняется прямой порядок слов (if + подлежащее + hadn't left), без did и без выноса вспомогательного глагола вперёд.

prompt: Checking the wet timetable at the shelter, Keiko asked the driver what time the last bus left.
answer: Checking the wet timetable at the shelter, Keiko asked the driver what time the last bus left.
accepted_answers: Checking the wet timetable at the shelter, Keiko asked the driver what time the last bus left.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: после what time стоит прямой порядок слов без did (the last bus left), а Present Simple сдвинут в Past Simple.

prompt: Seeing my empty plate, Lukas asked me, “What did you choose for lunch?” → Lukas asked me …
answer: Lukas asked me what I had chosen for lunch.
accepted_answers: Lukas asked me what I had chosen for lunch.
Lukas asked me what I'd chosen for lunch.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе местоимение you меняется на I, вспомогательный глагол did исчезает, а Past Simple сдвигается в Past Perfect (had chosen).

prompt: Marta heard a loud crash and found a ruined mug on the tiles. She phoned her partner at work straight away. He sighed and asked what (the cat / to break) before she got downstairs. Then he wondered (the kitten / to hide) under the sofa at that moment.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске речь о действии до спуска вниз, поэтому нужен Past Perfect после what; во втором вопрос о действии в тот момент передаётся через if/whether и Past Continuous.

prompt: Our street finally got a wooden playground behind the library. One sunny morning, Nabil stopped me by the gate for a quick chat. He asked (I / to see) the new swings yet. I hadn't, so I asked him how high (young children / can / to climb) on the wooden tower.
explanation_ru: Первый пропуск — общий вопрос с yet (нужны if/whether и сдвиг Present Perfect → Past Perfect); во втором после how high сохраняется прямой порядок слов и сдвиг can → could.

prompt: Owen spread a cycling map across the kitchen table before our weekend ride. Heavy traffic on the main road made him nervous. He asked Piotr which quiet lane (he / will / to follow) out of town. Then Owen wondered (the village café / to serve) hot soup on Sundays.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске после which quiet lane используется прямой порядок слов и сдвиг will → would; во втором общий вопрос о регулярном факте требует if/whether и Past Simple (served).

prompt: Everyone else joined the morning video call on time, so the manager phoned Rina and asked (she / not / to receive) the link the evening before.
explanation_ru: Отрицательный общий вопрос в Past Simple переходит в косвенную речь с союзом if/whether, прямым порядком слов и сдвигом в Past Perfect (if she hadn't received).

prompt: While preparing for our two-week trip to Lisbon, Samira called her neighbour and asked (who / to feed) the garden rabbits whenever the family travelled abroad.
explanation_ru: В вопросе к подлежащему (Who feeds…?) нет вспомогательного глагола do/does, поэтому в косвенной речи сохраняется структура who + глагол в Past Simple (who fed).

prompt: Right before the washing machine stopped working, the engineer asked Tunde had it been making a rattling noise during the spin cycle.
answer: Right before the washing machine stopped working, the engineer asked Tunde if it had been making a rattling noise during the spin cycle.
accepted_answers: Right before the washing machine stopped working, the engineer asked Tunde if it had been making a rattling noise during the spin cycle.
Right before the washing machine stopped working, the engineer asked Tunde whether it had been making a rattling noise during the spin cycle.
explanation_ru: В косвенном общем вопросе нельзя оставлять инверсию (had it been making): нужен союз if или whether и прямой порядок слов (if it had been making).

prompt: Viktor arrived at the clinic with dusty boots and a sore shoulder. The nurse glanced at his jacket and asked, “Were you repairing the roof when you slipped?” Which report is correct?
options: The nurse asked Viktor was he repairing the roof when he had slipped.
The nurse asked Viktor if had he been repairing the roof when he slipped.
The nurse asked Viktor if he had been repairing the roof when he slipped.
The nurse asked Viktor that he was repairing the roof when he slipped.
explanation_ru: Вопрос в Past Continuous (Were you repairing…?) в косвенной речи вводится через if/whether с прямым порядком слов и сдвигается в Past Perfect Continuous (if he had been repairing).

prompt: Wendy returned a faulty toaster to the department store after it scorched her kitchen wall. At the customer desk, the supervisor seemed reluctant to help at first. Later, I phoned Wendy and asked (the shop / to refund) the full price straight away. She sighed and wondered why (assistants / never / to explain) the return rules clearly. Then I asked what (she / will / to buy) with the refund.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске вопрос о прошлом действии требует if/whether и Past Perfect; во втором после wondered why нужен прямой порядок слов и Past Simple; в третьем will сдвигается в would.

prompt: Paint tins stood around the community hall while volunteers prepared for the weekend fair. Suddenly, Yusuf noticed the tall aluminium ladder was missing from the doorway. He asked Zara (who / to move) it during the tea break. She wasn't sure, so she asked the caretaker where (the decorators / to store) the spare steps. Meanwhile, I wondered (someone / to use) it out in the courtyard.
explanation_ru: Три разных решения: вопрос к подлежащему о более раннем действии (who had moved), специальный вопрос о постоянном месте (the decorators stored) и встроенный общий вопрос о текущем действии (if someone was using).
